query:
LTX 2.3 save-video fails at the end with [aac] Input contains (near) NaN/+-Inf across multiple workflows.
Kijai's workflow worked; replicating its parts into others did not fix it.

desired.outcome: Two confirmed root causes in thread: (1) FP8-format distilled LoRA incompatible with 22B model — removing it fixed NaN audio (lebakerino); (2) bad sigma values in the sigma node on two-pass setups (pappagheno).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests tracing a NaN from the AAC mux back to its latent source: FP8-format LoRA incompatible with the 22B model, or bad sigma values in a two-pass setup — not an ffmpeg/audio-encoder bug
